subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding the integral conceptually as the area under a curve
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student approximates the area under a curve using physical rectangle strips of decreasing width
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a shaded region under a graph to its approximate area estimate
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what a definite integral represents

misconception_flags: confuses the integral (accumulated area) with the derivative (rate of change)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
